_doc: Adversarial tailored resumes for verify_resume.py. Each case patches resume-good.json. expect: block = verify must fail and a block message must contain 'msg'; warn = must pass with a warn containing 'msg'; pass = must pass (legit rewrite); miss = known gap, verify passes today and the tailor reviewer pass must catch it. patch ops: set (path, value), append (path, value). fact_patch appends a bullet to the fact bank before verifying.
